title: Create and Format a Professional Letter
description: Create a formal application letter with proper formatting, alignment, headers, and footers in MS Word.
objective: Students will create a professionally formatted letter in MS Word, applying font formatting (Bold, Italic, Underline), text alignment, headers and footers, page setup, and proper document saving techniques.

steps.title: Create the Document and Set Page Layout
steps.instructions:
1. Open Microsoft Word (Start Menu → Microsoft Word, or press **Win + R**, type `winword`, press Enter).
2. Create a new blank document by pressing **Ctrl + N**.
3. Set the page margins:
   - Go to **Layout** tab → **Margins** → **Custom Margins**
   - Set all four margins (Top, Bottom, Left, Right) to **1.5 inches**
   - Click **OK**
4. Set the paper orientation to **Portrait** (Layout → Orientation → Portrait).
5. Verify the paper size is set to **A4** (Layout → Size → A4).

**CCC Exam Connection:** Default margins are 1 inch. Default orientation is Portrait. Default paper size in India is A4.

steps.title: Type the Letter Content
steps.instructions:
Type the following letter content:

```
Rahul Sharma
45, MG Road, Arera Colony
Bhopal - 462016
26 July 2026

The Director
TechPath Institute
MP Nagar, Zone-II
Bhopal - 462011

Subject: Application for Admission to CCC Course

Respected Sir/Madam,

I am writing to apply for admission to the CCC (Course on Computer Concepts) program at TechPath Institute. I have completed my graduation from Barkatullah University and wish to enhance my computer skills.

I understand that the CCC course covers word processing, spreadsheets, internet, and email. The NIELIT certification will help me qualify for government job requirements. I am ready to pay the course fee of Rs. 3,000 and can join the August 2026 batch.

Kindly consider my application and confirm my admission.

Thanking you,
Yours faithfully,

Rahul Sharma
```

**Tips:**
- Press **Enter** only to start a new paragraph or blank line.
- Let Word wrap text automatically at the end of lines.
- Use **Shift + Enter** if you need a line break without a paragraph gap (e.g., in the address).

steps.title: Apply Text Formatting
steps.instructions:
Now format the letter using these techniques:

**Sender's Name (Rahul Sharma at top):**
- Select the name → change font to **Arial**, size **14pt**
- Press **Ctrl + B** to make it Bold

**Subject Line:**
- Select the entire subject line
- Press **Ctrl + B** for Bold
- Press **Ctrl + U** for Underline

**"Respected Sir/Madam":**
- Select it → press **Ctrl + I** for Italic

**Body Text (all paragraphs):**
- Select all body paragraphs
- Change font to **Times New Roman**, size **12pt**
- Press **Ctrl + J** to Justify the text

**"TechPath Institute" (wherever it appears):**
- Use **Ctrl + H** (Find and Replace) is not needed here — just select each occurrence and press **Ctrl + B**

**"Rs. 3,000":**
- Select it → press **Ctrl + B** for Bold
- Change the font colour to **Red** (Home tab → Font Color dropdown → Red)

**Date and Closing:**
- Select the date line → press **Ctrl + R** (Right align)
- Select "Yours faithfully" and the signature name → press **Ctrl + R**

**CCC Exam Connection:** Ctrl+B = Bold, Ctrl+I = Italic, Ctrl+U = Underline, Ctrl+J = Justify, Ctrl+R = Right align.

steps.title: Add Header, Footer, and Page Number
steps.instructions:
**Add a Header:**
1. Go to **Insert** tab → **Header** → choose **Blank** style
2. Type: **Application Letter — TechPath Institute**
3. Make it Italic and font size 10pt
4. Click **Close Header and Footer** (or double-click in the document area)

**Add a Footer with Page Number:**
1. Go to **Insert** tab → **Footer** → choose **Blank** style
2. Go to **Insert** tab → **Page Number** → **Current Position** → choose a simple number format
3. Center-align the page number in the footer
4. Click **Close Header and Footer**

**Add a Page Border:**
1. Go to **Design** tab → **Page Borders**
2. Select **Box** under Setting
3. Choose a solid line style with **1.5 pt** width
4. Click **OK**

**CCC Exam Connection:** Headers/Footers are in the Insert tab. Page Borders are in the Design tab. Page numbers can be placed in headers or footers.

steps.title: Spell Check, Preview, and Save
steps.instructions:
**Run Spelling and Grammar Check:**
1. Press **F7** to start the spell checker
2. Review each flagged word — click **Change** to accept corrections or **Ignore** to skip
3. Verify no red or blue wavy underlines remain

**Preview the Document:**
1. Press **Ctrl + P** to open Print Preview
2. Check that the letter looks professional — margins are correct, header/footer visible, formatting is clean
3. Press **Esc** to close the preview

**Save the Document:**
1. Press **Ctrl + S** to save
2. Choose a location (e.g., Desktop or Documents folder)
3. Name the file: **Letter_CCC_Application.docx**
4. Click **Save**

**Save as PDF:**
1. Press **F12** (Save As)
2. Change "Save as type" to **PDF**
3. Name it: **Letter_CCC_Application.pdf**
4. Click **Save**

**CCC Exam Connection:** F7 = Spell Check. Ctrl+P = Print/Preview. Ctrl+S = Save. F12 = Save As. Default format is .docx.
